_why: The DECLARED state of every GitHub-side control. scripts/ghaudit.py compares this to the live API and exits non-zero on a difference. Before this file, that state was typed into SECURITY.md and docs/GITHUB-FINALIZATION.md with a date beside it: true when written, unfalsifiable later, and stale without saying so. A declaration a machine can compare is the only kind that cannot rot quietly.

ruleset.name: main-protection
ruleset._checks_note: These are CHECK RUN names — the `name:` of a job — not workflow names. A ruleset naming a check that never reports blocks every merge, so `Atlas CI` (the workflow) would wedge the branch while `Contract` (its job) gates it.

_not_required_yet.Analyze (python): CodeQL default setup. Measured on PR #1: it reported failure there from an advanced workflow that no longer exists on main, and `Analyze (actions)` did not report at all. A context that does not report on every pull request blocks every merge.
